summary: S05 (§882.13, FRQ 2014-2027) re-derived from the ledger, three design volumes, the ENC/lighting receipts and the product trees at 9a0584f0f, 30c1667bc and 4233031ba. Net: the delegation reading and the five holds hold; the pre-launch boundary is sound in substance but is an UNNAMED supersession of four same-day classifications that called persisted shape owner-by-nature (§881.6, LIGHTING §7, HORIZON §19 :1240, DESIGN_ENCOUNTERS §12 preamble) and its 'carries no migration' overstates (OSR governed migrations are still owed); 5b NO is ratified as an application of §881.11/§881.10(1) with a citation error and a superseded fence-3 description; WK-11 KEEP is executed evidence. Three rulings the row counts as done are NOT executed at any tip and are read by the lanes as still owner-pending: RR-10 (readerCorpus.mjs at 4233031ba says the opposite in a comment), ENC rows 2 and 3 (respect coerces to friendship, rivalry refused, 'until the owner rules the rivalry word'). Row 6's kind name and 5b's fence 3 were superseded later and the stratum does not mark it. Verdicts: RATIFY 10 · AMEND 7 · no REVERSE; one EVIDENCE-THIN note (row 13's docket) is carried inside S05-17. Porcelain unchanged on every dock touched.
